title: Typography—Serif: Times Roman
slide_intent: Teach designers to choose a face that remains readable in small news text and still supports clear changes of emphasis.
strategic_value: NASA can give newsletters a familiar sustained reading texture and retain flexibility in their headings.
demonstration: Times Roman and Times Roman Bold specimens sit above two paragraph settings. One uses Helvetica Medium headings and one uses Times Roman Bold.
practical_value: Compare the two heading options at the intended column width before setting a newsletter or other text-heavy publication.

content_islands.name: Family rationale
content_islands.spec: Use the top columns to relate the face’s large x-height and available styles to news and long-volume settings.

content_islands.name: Character comparison
content_islands.spec: Stack regular and bold alphabets, figures and symbols at a common left edge. Label the weights.

content_islands.name: News text settings
content_islands.spec: Show broad and narrow reading measures beneath the specimen rule. Pair each with its heading and point-size annotation.
